records.description: Never lose a useful AI answer again. OutlineSave turns ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and DeepSeek chats into searchable offline HTML or Markdown you can revisit anytime. • Structured: Auto 2-level outlines, search, highlights, notes, and bookmarks. • Local-first: Save conversations as local files you control. • Private: Runs in your browser. No account required. •Flexible: Export to Markdown or searchable HTML with filters, or back up to your own Google Drive. • Try free: 7-day trial, no card needed.

records.name: SciNest
records.tagline: Upload once. Create editable writing, figures and slides.
records.description: Stop uploading the same papers and explaining the same project to every AI tool. SciNest lets you add papers, notes, drafts, feedback and data once, then use the shared project context to create academic writing, scientific figures and presentations. Every output stays editable, reusable and connected to the next task—not trapped in another chat. It runs local-first and works with your own AI key, so you can choose the models you trust.

records.name: WaveApp
records.tagline: WaveApp is mobile interface for Wavespeed.ai full AI models
records.description: If you know what Wavespeed.ai is then you know how large this service is it offers about 1000 AI models that can do anything, imagine you have a mobile application that can use the power of Wavespeed.ai in the mobile friendly interface that harness the entire Wavespeed.ai models, what you need is to get wavespeed api key, add it to the WaveApp, and you are ready to go mobile mode.

records.name: ComplyCheck  Video Compliance Analyser
records.tagline: Check your video for policy compliance before posting.
records.description: **ComplyCheck AI** helps you analyze your videos before uploading them to social media. Using AI, it checks your content against the latest guidelines for Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok,Facebook,Linkdin,Snapshot helping identify potential policy violations and factors that may reduce your video's reach. Receive a clear compliance report, fix issues before publishing, and post with confidence. Ideal for creators, marketers, agencies, and businesses looking to create platform-compliant content.

records.name: Nuze
records.tagline: Tap any headline, get the research behind it
records.description: Every AI news app summarizes the article you already have open. Nuze goes outward instead: tap a story and Claude runs a live web search for the background, sources linked. Then read it in any of 14 languages, or listen. Free, no ads, no signup.

records.name: GlacialBooks
records.tagline: Autonomous bookkeeping for creators and small businesses
records.description: GlacialBooks is autonomous bookkeeping for the businesses the big platforms overlook: contractors, creators, agencies, and small service based companies. Link your accounts, Arko does work overnight, categorizing activity, reconciling to the ledger, running month end close, leaving only items that need a human to review in the morning. The features they actually need, like splitting expenses across jobs, are missing in tools made for enterprises. We built for the smaller operator. Start free.

records.name: Aduki Hermers
records.tagline: Mail infrastructure engineered for the machine age.
records.description: Hermers mail infrastructure engineered for the machine age. One relay engine speaking IMAP, SMTP, JMAP, CalDAV, gRPC, REST, and MCP against a single source of truth. Legacy clients connect with zero config; AI agents get native MCP tools instead of raw inbox access, no PII in context. Delta-sync, exactly-once delivery, auto DKIM/DMARC/SPF. Now in private Early Access Beta: dedicated sandbox, priority access, free during testing. 👉 hermers.aduki.org/soon

records.name: Nysos
records.tagline: AI that clips your streams the moment they end
records.description: Most AI clippers wait for you to paste a VOD. Nysos watches your Twitch or Kick channel and starts clipping the second your stream ends — vertical, captioned clips, each graded A→F with the reasons. 60 free min/month, no card.

records.name: 97AI.PRO
records.tagline: From inspiration to final video, 97AI makes creation easier.
records.description: 97AI is a pay-per-use marketplace for 360+ top AI models behind one API and one credit wallet: video generation (Veo, Seedance, Wan), image, music, and chat models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, Kimi). Prices run 30-84% below official APIs, with an hourly price sync and a fully public per-model pricing page. Zero-risk billing means failed generations cost $0. Free starting credits on signup; top up from $5 via credit card, Alipay, WeChat Pay, or USDC. Available in 5 languages.

records.name: Lilaven
records.tagline: The bedtime ritual app that dims the world with you
records.description: Lilaven is a calm evening app built around Lilac Drifts — an interactive sleep ritual where soft scenes, gentle narration, and quiet gestures ease you toward rest. Also includes: audio sleep stories, 150+ calming music tracks, breathing exercises, and the Release Ritual (write what weighs on you, watch it burn away). Available on iOS and Android. English, German, Japanese.

records.name: TradeOnMath
records.tagline: Trade on math, not on hope.
records.description: Free calculators that reveal the honest mathematical reality of your strategy — expectancy, risk of ruin, position sizing — plus education without the hype.

records.name: ShiftSwap
records.tagline: The simplest way for teams to swap shifts
records.description: ShiftSwap makes it easy for teams to swap shifts without the chaos of group chats. Post available shifts, request swaps, get manager approvals, and track everything in one place. Built for hospitals, restaurants, retail, security, and other shift-based teams. Try it free — no signup needed: https://shift-swap-hub-alpha.vercel.app Click “Try Demo”

records.name: Orion Backgammon
records.tagline: 5,000 years of backgammon. A new world begins.
records.description: Orion Backgammon on your phone: provably fair dice, real ranked seasons and living worlds. Premium online backgammon, free to play.

records.name: WP Duty
records.tagline: Meet WP Duty: Your AI WordPress Operator
records.description: WP Duty is an agentic AI operator for WordPress. Tell it what to do in plain language; it executes on your site, shows a diff to approve, and snapshots every change so it can always be undone. Built for agencies and freelancers.

records.name: DataOrigin
records.tagline: Find your ideal clients at every trade show
records.description: DataOrigin is a B2B lead generation platform for trade shows. It identifies the companies exhibiting and attending each event, ranks them by fit with your ideal customer profile, and helps you reach decision-makers before the show.

records.name: PunchInn
records.tagline: All-in-One HR, Attendance & Payroll Software
records.description: All-in-one HR, attendance and payroll software for any team size or industry. Works with any biometric device, plus web and mobile GPS clock-in. Start free.

records.name: GetNotes
records.tagline: AI meeting notes for the room, not the call in 90+ languages
records.description: Otter and Fireflies join your Zoom. But what about the meeting happening around a table? GetNotes records in-person meetings straight from your phone no app, no bot and writes speaker-labelled minutes in 90+ languages: summary, decisions, action items. Your first meeting is free.

records.name: TradingPal
records.tagline: Find the setup. See the track record.
records.description: TradingPal finds wedges, trendlines, and consolidation breakouts across stocks, crypto, and ETFs—the same kinds of setups successful momentum swing traders have built strategies around. Every qualifying setup comes with its historical win rate, expected R, profit factor, and drawdown.

records.name: Rivadar
records.tagline: Discover and analyze competitors for your SaaS ideas
records.description: Discover and verify product competitors, then compare positioning, features, pricing, and business models in source-backed competitor analysis reports.

records.name: Speaking Time Calculator
records.tagline: Hit Your Target Time, Every Single Speech.
records.description: Calculate your speech time accurately based on word count and speaking pace. Free tool with teleprompter.

records.name: StackHuddle
records.tagline: The game that trains fast thinking and clear speaking
records.description: StackHuddle turns quick thinking and clear speaking into a game. You get a topic, a 2-minute research sprint with an AI assistant, then you present out loud — concisely, from memory — while your mic transcribes you. An AI judge scores accuracy, depth, clarity, and coverage with specific feedback, so every round makes you a sharper speaker. Play head-to-head with up to 5 friends, or solo with a score history to track your progress. Browser-based, no installs; guests join with just a link.

records.name: CSV Cleanroom
records.tagline: Clean messy CSVs locally—no uploads or subscriptions
records.description: CSV Cleanroom is a private, offline CSV cleaning utility. It detects delimiters, normalizes headers, trims whitespace, removes blank and duplicate rows, infers column types, and exports Excel-friendly UTF-8 CSV files. Everything runs in your browser, so files never leave your device.

records.name: Vardin Scamguard
records.tagline: Your AI-powered shield against scams, phishing, and fraud.
records.description: Vardin Scamguard is a scam detection app for the whole family - help keep your kids, parents and yourself safe from scams - peace of mind from losing money - all in one place

records.name: Freelancer Invoice & Cash Flow Tracker
records.tagline: A full invoicing tool that's just one HTML file
records.description: Freelancer Invoice & Cash Flow Tracker is a single HTML file that replaces expensive invoicing SaaS. No install, no account, no monthly fee — just open it in your browser. Create print-ready invoices with auto-calculating line items, track clients and their running totals, log income/expenses, and see everything on a live dashboard. All your data stays local — nothing is ever uploaded anywhere.

records.name: MusVideo
records.tagline: AI music video generator for creators
records.description: Turn your music into cinematic AI videos in minutes. Upload an MP3 or use a music link, add prompts or reference images, and let AI generate a complete music video with synchronized visuals. Built for musicians, creators, and anyone who wants to bring their songs to life—without editing skills.

records.name: The Sync
records.tagline: Trust people for what they’ve done, not followers they have.
records.description: TheSync is a professional social network where only verified professionals can create content. Every creator is verified through work experience, portfolios, projects, certifications, or other relevant evidence, making discussions more credible and valuable. Share text, images, videos, and join niche communities to learn, network, and collaborate without fake experts or anonymous noise.

records.name: Lumora
records.tagline: Lumora — Your Style. Your Sound. Your Story.
records.description: A modern social experience combining creativity, music, and beautiful design.

records.name: Socienta
records.tagline: The Complete PropTech Platform for UAE Real Estate.
records.description: Socienta is a UAE-based PropTech SaaS platform that simplifies property and community management through intelligent automation. Our integrated solution combines accounting, leasing, Procure-to-Pay, vendor management, service charge accounting, customer experience, and business intelligence in one platform. Built for real estate professionals, Socienta helps organizations improve efficiency, streamline operations, enhance decision-making, and drive sustainable growth.

records.name: Make a Receipt
records.tagline: Create professional receipts online in minutes ⭐
records.description: The easiest way to make a receipt online. Choose a template, customize your details, and download for free - no account needed. Make a receipt today!

records.name: Seedance Check
records.tagline: Check whether a video was made with Seedance
records.description: A free, no-sign-up video provenance checker that queries both Volcengine and BytePlus official verification nodes.

records.name: Korvix3D
records.tagline: Subscription Marketplace for 3D Models
records.description: Discover, download, and sell high-quality 3D models. Join the premier platform for 3D artists and studios worldwide. Native plugins for Blender, Maya, 3DS Max, Cinema 4D, Unity, Unreal Engine.

records.name: Blueprints
records.tagline: World's market place for Blueprint
records.description: Download implementation-ready blueprints for business, AI, technology, marketing, operations, software, finance, education, productivity, and thousands of other topics.
